say:1:1310927001:1.text: It's you again. Apologies, but like I said before, the Hierophant is currently not receiving any guests.
say:1:1310927001:1.source_cn: 又是你们。很抱歉，我之前已经说过了，大主教阁下目前不接...

choice_prompt:2:1310927001.text: It's you again. Apologies, but like I said before, the Hierophant is currently not receiving any guests.
choice_prompt:2:1310927001.source_cn: 又是你们。很抱歉，我之前已经说过了，大主教阁下目前不接见任何客人。

say:3:1310927003:1.text: Of course! However, His Excellency has not given any instructions, or if he did, I was not told since I'm only responsible for guarding the entrance.
say:3:1310927003:1.source_cn: 当然见到了！但大主教阁下并没有其他的吩咐。哦，或许他有...

say:4:1310927004:1.text: But how come the Hierophant isn't saying anything about what's happening? Does he not care about the people here?
say:4:1310927004:1.source_cn: 可是……这么重要的事情，大主教怎么能毫无反应？他……他...

say:5:1310927005:1.text: It's not your place to judge the Hierophant!

say:6:1310927006:1.text: Don't you understand? The people of Cedartown are trapped in a time loop. They've all turned into snowmen. Maybe the Hypogeans are doing something! We have to see him!
say:6:1310927006:1.source_cn: 你难道没有听懂吗？雪松镇的人陷入了时间循环，都变成了雪...

say:7:1310927007:0.text: I don't care about time loops and the like. My first priority is to ensure that His Excellency has the peace and quiet he needs to recuperate.
say:7:1310927007:0.source_cn: 无论什么循环，我的首要任务是保证大主教阁下处于安静的休...

say:8:1310927008:1.text: You're going against Dura's teachings! You don't care about the people of Cedartown at all!
say:8:1310927008:1.source_cn: 你们……你们这是违背艾雅女神的教导！你们根本不关心雪松...

say:9:1310927009:1.text: Without the express permission of the Hierophant, I cannot let you in.
say:9:1310927009:1.source_cn: 没有大主教阁下的允许，我不能放你们进去。

say:10:1310927010:1.text: Please go consult with His Excellency. We assure you we shall remain outside.
say:10:1310927010:1.source_cn: 你可以去询问大主教阁下，我们保证不闯进去。

say:11:1310927011:1.text: Out of the question. We cannot disturb the Hierophant's rest.
say:11:1310927011:1.source_cn: 不行，不能打扰大主教阁下的休养。

say:14:1310927013:1.text: If you barge into the temple, you will be punished by the goddess herself.
say:14:1310927013:1.source_cn: 你们不能擅闯大教堂，否则会受到神的惩罚！

say:15:1310927015:1.text: Wait! He's right. We ought not to trespass on holy ground.
say:15:1310927015:1.source_cn: ——等等！他说得对，我们不该擅闯圣所。

say:16:1310927016:1.text: I apologize if my associates have been somewhat hasty. Since His Excellency is not receiving visitors, we shall take our leave.
say:16:1310927016:1.source_cn: 修士先生，很抱歉，我的同伴有些冲动。既然大主教阁下不见...

say:18:1310927018:1.text: Shhh... Lower your voice. Follow me.
say:18:1310927018:1.source_cn: 嘘，小声点……你们先随我来。

choice:13:0:1.text: Get out of my way or else.
choice:13:0:1.male: Get out of my way or else.
choice:13:0:1.female: Get out of my way or else.

say:20:1310927014:1.text: How dare you provoke the holy temple?!
say:20:1310927014:1.male: How dare you provoke the holy temple?!
say:20:1310927014:1.female: How dare you provoke the holy temple?!

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 那位修士见到大主教了吗？

say:21:1310927002:1.text: I know the matter is serious, but for the sake of His Excellency's health, I cannot let you in.
say:21:1310927002:1.source_cn: 我知道事情严重，但为了大主教阁下能够尽早恢复健康，我不...

choice_prompt:22:1310927002.text: I know the matter is serious, but for the sake of His Excellency's health, I cannot let you in.
choice_prompt:22:1310927002.source_cn: 我知道事情严重，但为了大主教阁下能够尽早恢复健康，我不能让你们进入。

choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 那么，那位修士见到大主教了吗？

choice:2:1:2.text: But the situation is very serious!
choice:2:1:2.male: But the situation is very serious!
choice:2:1:2.female: But the situation is very serious!

say:1:1310928001:1.text: So, what are you planning, Valka?

say:2:1310928002:1.text: I suspect that something is amiss within the temple's walls. They are preventing the Hierophant from seeing anyone. It's possible that he's under house arrest...
say:2:1310928002:1.source_cn: 我也觉得修道院有问题。他们一直不让大主教露面，也许大主...

say:3:1310928003:1.text: If this is true, they must be expecting that someone will inevitably find out. We would face losses if we were to force our entry.
say:3:1310928003:1.source_cn: 如果真是这样，他们一定早就做好了准备，硬闯会吃亏。

say:4:1310928004:1.text: I have a friend who is likely to possess a method for us to infiltrate the temple undetected.
say:4:1310928004:1.source_cn: 我认识一位朋友，她应该有办法让我们悄悄潜入修道院大教堂...

say:5:1310928005:1.text: Infiltrate... Yes, that's a great idea. We can get more information if we don't alert them.
say:5:1310928005:1.source_cn: 潜入……嗯，这个主意不错。不惊动他们，我们才能获得更多...

say:6:1310928006:1.text: People always say that being hasty won't amount to anything.
say:6:1310928006:1.source_cn: 你说得对，光心急办不了大事。

say:7:1310928007:1.text: Let's go find your friend first. Chippy really hopes that Callahan isn't in trouble...
say:7:1310928007:1.source_cn: 先去找你的朋友吧。满满希望那位虔诚的修士杨凯维奇先生不...

say:0:1310929001:0.text: Follow me. My friend resides not too far from the temple.
say:0:1310929001:0.source_cn: 跟我来，我的朋友就住在离修道院不远的地方。

say:1:1310929002:0.text: However, her residence is somewhat... odd. Do not let it concern you.
say:1:1310929002:0.source_cn: 不过她居住的地方比较……奇特，你们不要介意。

say:0:1311002001:0.text: It's all ruins here... Where is your friend?
say:0:1311002001:0.source_cn: 这里都是废墟……你的朋友在哪？

narration:0:1311003001:1.text: Valka knocks on the door. The sound echoes throughout the ruins, but no one answers.

say:2:1311003002:1.text: Curious... Is she not here? Perhaps she is praying and did not hear us.
say:2:1311003002:1.source_cn: 奇怪……她不在吗？唔……或许是在祈祷，没有听见……

say:3:1311003003:1.text: Your friend lives in a crypt...?
say:3:1311003003:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，这里就是你那位朋友的家？她……住在地道里？

say:4:1311003004:1.text: Indeed. This is Carolina's home. This place was once the ancestral mansion of her kin. Her family was once one of the three great noble families in these parts.
say:4:1311003004:1.source_cn: 没错。这是卡列琳娜——我这位朋友——的家，这里以前是她...

say:6:1311003006:1.text: Now...? Similar to the remnants here... Dead, decayed, and forgotten.
say:6:1311003006:1.source_cn: 现在……和这片废墟一样死去，腐朽，然后被遗忘了。

say:7:1311003007:1.text: Time is of the essence. We cannot afford to wait idly for her here. Come with me. Let us seek the <style="highlight">undead flames</style> to unlock the door.
say:7:1311003007:1.source_cn: 时间紧迫，不能在外面干等她。跟我来，我们去拿开门用的<...

choice_prompt:8:1311003007.text: Time is of the essence. We cannot afford to wait idly for her here. Come with me. Let us seek the <style="highlight">undead flames</style> to unlock the door.
choice_prompt:8:1311003007.source_cn: 时间紧迫，不能在外面干等她。跟我来，我们去拿开门用的<style=highlight>亡灵之焰</style>。

say:9:1311003008:1.text: They are known among mortals as will-o'-wisps. We can utilize these flames to light the lamps on the door and thus gain access.
say:9:1311003008:1.source_cn: 就是你们常说的“鬼火”。用亡灵之焰点亮门上的灯盏，就可...

say:10:1311003011:1.text: So, these "undead flames" are like keys. Is the place where they're kept far from here?
say:10:1311003011:1.source_cn: 呃，看来“亡灵之焰”就是开门用的钥匙，放钥匙的地方离这...

say:11:1311003012:1.text: Carolina holds a deep-seated love for this estate and has never left its confines, and the so-called "keys" reside within the ruins of the mansion.
say:11:1311003012:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜对这座宅邸充满感情，一直不曾远离此地。打开暗门...

say:12:1311003013:1.text: Uh... Chippy has a question. If you put your special key where others can get it, doesn't that defeat the purpose of locking your secret door?
say:12:1311003013:1.source_cn: 呃……满满有个问题，把暗门的钥匙放在别人能拿到的地方，...

say:13:1311003014:1.text: In truth, having a secure door is inconsequential. It may be essential when one is alive. However, for us, who have experienced death and endured for eons, wealth and material possessions are of no import.
say:13:1311003014:1.source_cn: 其实，“锁门”毫无意义。在生前或许需要，但对我们这样先...

say:14:1311003015:1.text: We've witnessed those that we hold dear pass away one by one. Our surroundings slowly change into the unfamiliar, until no link remains. In the end, we can only live in the ruins of our past, reminiscing and suffering the torture of our memories...
say:14:1311003015:1.source_cn: 你亲眼看着认识的人渐渐死去，周围一切慢慢变得陌生，最后...

say:15:1311003016:1.text: People here fear us, cursing our names and ostracizing us. Ha... They wouldn't even dare come near, let alone steal or rob from this place.
say:15:1311003016:1.source_cn: 更何况，这里的人们害怕我们、诅咒和远离我们。哈……他们...

say:16:1311003017:1.text: Locking the door serves more as a ritual, a memento of sorts. It gives us the feeling that we are not entirely dead and provides a semblance of our former lives.
say:16:1311003017:1.source_cn: 所谓的“锁门”更像是一种仪式，或者纪念。这会让我们感觉...

say:17:1311003018:1.text: I didn't know becoming a Graveborn was so dreadful...
say:17:1311003018:1.source_cn: 原来成为永生的亡灵，是这么痛苦的事情……

say:18:1311003019:1.text: Not every Graveborn is subjected to such pain. Let's not dwell on it. The undead flames lie amidst the <style="highlight">ruins of the main manor</style>. We need to open the door as soon as possible.
say:18:1311003019:1.source_cn: 并不是所有的亡灵都这么痛苦……算了，不提这些。亡灵之焰...

say:20:1311003009:1.text: Yes, Carolina and I have been acquainted for a long time, and we have always enjoyed a cordial relationship.
say:20:1311003009:1.source_cn: 嗯，我和卡列琳娜认识很久，关系一向不错。

say:21:1311003010:1.text: Should you employ the specific undead flames to light the lamps on the door, it shall unlock.
say:21:1311003010:1.source_cn: 只要用特定的亡灵之焰点亮门上的灯盏，就可以打开这扇暗门了。

choice:8:1:2.text: You know how to open the door?
choice:8:1:2.male: You know how to open the door?
choice:8:1:2.female: You know how to open the door?

say:1:1311004001:1.text: That is the undead flame. However, there is but a single flame present here... Odd, there ought to be a pair of flames together.
say:1:1311004001:1.source_cn: 就是它了，亡灵之焰。不过这里只有一盏……奇怪，应该两盏...

say:2:1311004002:1.text: Did someone steal it? Or did it secretly run away? Chippy has heard that some will-o'-wisps like wandering around...
say:2:1311004002:1.source_cn: 会不会被别人拿走了？或者……它自己偷偷跑掉了！满满听说...

say:3:1311004003:1.text: This type of flame does not typically wander off on its own, and there appear to be no human tracks in the vicinity.
say:3:1311004003:1.source_cn: 这种注魔的亡灵火焰可不会自己乱飘的，这附近也没有人类足迹。

choice_prompt:4:1311004003.text: This type of flame does not typically wander off on its own, and there appear to be no human tracks in the vicinity.
choice_prompt:4:1311004003.source_cn: 这种注魔的亡灵火焰可不会自己乱飘的，这附近也没有人类足迹。

say:5:1311004004:1.text: This entire region was once the property of Carolina's family. She may have placed a second undead flame in another part of the estate.
say:5:1311004004:1.source_cn: 嗯，这片区域曾经都是卡列琳娜家族的领地，或许她将另一盏...

say:6:1311004005:1.text: All of this used to belong to her family?! Wow, she must've had a very comfortable life.
say:6:1311004005:1.source_cn: 全都是她的家族领地！哇，那她的生活一定很优渥舒适。

say:8:1311004008:1.text: Let us venture further into the valley to the east.
say:8:1311004008:1.source_cn: 我们可以去东边的山谷深处再找找看。

say:9:1311004009:1.text: That region was once Carolina's family garden, and further along, there is a clearing that served as a small hunting ground, which, naturally, was also a part of her property.
say:9:1311004009:1.source_cn: 那一带曾是卡列琳娜家的花园，再往深处是一个小型猎场，当...

say:10:1311004010:1.text: What kind of person is she?
say:10:1311004010:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，卡列琳娜是个怎样的人？

say:11:1311004011:1.text: ... When I perished in battle, Carolina had not yet been born. When we crossed paths inadvertently, she had already transformed into a Graveborn.
say:11:1311004011:1.source_cn: ……我战死的时候，卡列琳娜还远未出生。我和她偶然相识的...

say:12:1311004012:1.text: I was surprised when I saw her. She was a noblewoman, unassuming and tranquil as a peaceful lake... What cause had the God of Death to bestow the Graveborn curse upon her?
say:12:1311004012:1.source_cn: 见到她的时候，我很惊讶。她是一位贵族少女，湖泊般谦逊又...

say:13:1311004013:1.text: How did she become a Graveborn?
say:13:1311004013:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜她……是怎么成为亡灵的？

say:14:1311004014:1.text: All I know is that her family maintained a deep connection to the temple. If we wish to gain entry into Whiteridge Temple, she may possess the means to help us.
say:14:1311004014:1.source_cn: 我只知道她的家族与圣堂私交甚密，如果想要进入白山大教堂...

say:15:1311004015:1.text: As to how she became a Graveborn, she never disclosed it to me, nor did I inquire, and indeed, I had no desire to ask...
say:15:1311004015:1.source_cn: 至于她为何成为亡灵，她没有告诉过我，我没有问，也不想问。

say:16:1311004016:1.text: Back to the task at hand. Let us be off.

say:18:1311004007:1.text: There are a few puzzling marks in the area... They appear to have been left at the main manor. But these were not created by humans, and they do not seem to be the tracks of animals.
say:18:1311004007:1.source_cn: 周围有一些奇怪的痕迹……嗯，似乎最后离开了主宅。但不是...

say:1:1311005001:1.text: The undead flame isn't here. Let's keep going.
say:1:1311005001:1.source_cn: 亡灵之焰没在这里，咱们再往深处走走吧！

say:2:1311005002:1.text: This was her family's garden. I recall Carolina mentioning that in her youth, she was fond of boating, and her father had a love for fishing. Playfully, she would churn the waters to frighten away the fish that were nearly caught.
say:2:1311005002:1.source_cn: ……这里曾是她家的花园。我记得卡列琳娜说过，小时候，她...

say:3:1311005003:1.text: Her father never grew angry but would chuckle, lift her up, and tickle her with his beard. It paints a lovely picture, does it not?
say:3:1311005003:1.source_cn: 她的父亲从来都不生气 ，而是会哈哈大笑着抱起她，用胡子...

say:4:1311005004:1.text: It does! It's a shame that Chippy and Hammie don't have parents... But it's alright! We have the magister!
say:4:1311005004:1.source_cn: 对呀！可惜满满和漫漫是使魔，都没有父母……没关系，但满...
say:4:1311005004:1.male: It does! It's a shame that Chippy and Hammie don't have parents... But it's alright! We have the magister!
say:4:1311005004:1.female: It does! It's a shame that Chippy and Hammie don't have parents... But it's alright! We have the magister!

choice_prompt:5:1311005004.text: It does! It's a shame that Chippy and Hammie don't have parents... But it's alright! We have the magister!
choice_prompt:5:1311005004.source_cn: 对呀！可惜满满和漫漫是使魔，都没有父母……没关系，但满满有主人！
choice_prompt:5:1311005004.male: It does! It's a shame that Chippy and Hammie don't have parents... But it's alright! We have the magister!
choice_prompt:5:1311005004.female: It does! It's a shame that Chippy and Hammie don't have parents... But it's alright! We have the magister!

say:6:1311005005:1.source_cn: 那后来呢？卡列琳娜还讲过什么？

say:7:1311005006:0.text: With the passage of time, although the Hypogeans had vanished, their minions continued to roam the land. Numerous wars broke out, resulting in the deaths of many, Carolina included.
say:7:1311005006:0.source_cn: 后来……虽然恶魔已经消失，但魔物仍然在大地上徘徊。这片...

say:8:1311005007:1.text: She was granted the protection of the temple, and despite her becoming a Graveborn, the acolytes silently allowed her to reside near the temple's grounds.
say:8:1311005007:1.source_cn: 她得到了圣堂的庇护，就算成为了亡灵，修士们也默许她可以...

say:9:1311005008:1.text: Why is that? Aren't all the people scared of the Graveborn here?
say:9:1311005008:1.source_cn: 为什么？这里的人们不是都很害怕亡灵吗？

say:10:1311005009:1.text: Carolina voluntarily sought to enter the temple in service to the goddess. Had she not met an untimely death, it is quite plausible that she would have become a saint, garnering the praise and admiration of the people.
say:10:1311005009:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜曾主动进入修道院侍奉女神。如果不是过早逝世，她...

say:11:1311005010:1.text: Therefore, to slip into the temple undetected, she is our best chance. No one is more knowledgeable about that building than she.
say:11:1311005010:1.source_cn: 所以，如果我们想要悄悄进入大教堂，找她是最好的办法。不...

say:0:1311005101:0.text: Follow me. Let us venture deeper into the valley to the east.
say:0:1311005101:0.source_cn: 来吧，我们再去东边的山谷深处找找。

say:1:1311005102:0.text: Ascend the cliff and peer into the distance.

say:0:1311005201:0.text: Look! Isn't that the undead flame? Wait... is that ice all around it?
say:0:1311005201:0.source_cn: 看，前面那不是亡灵之焰吗！咦，周围有很多……冰？

say:1:1311006001:1.text: We've found it. So, these ice elementals were responsible for bringing the undead flame here.
say:1:1311006001:1.source_cn: 找到了，原来是这些冰元素把亡灵之焰带走了。

say:2:1311006002:1.text: These ice elementals are stronger than any I've seen. Must be the cold of Whiteridge Mountain... I wonder if they can be taught some manners—it's quite rude to take things without permission!
say:2:1311006002:1.source_cn: 这些冰元素比我之前见过的都强大，或许是因为白山足够寒冷...
say:2:1311006002:1.male: These ice elementals are stronger than any I've seen. Must be the cold of Whiteridge Mountain... I wonder if they can be taught some manners—it's quite rude to take things without permission!
say:2:1311006002:1.female: These ice elementals are stronger than any I've seen. Must be the cold of Whiteridge Mountain... I wonder if they can be taught some manners—it's quite rude to take things without permission!

say:3:1311006003:0.text: Uh, Valka, is this a part of Lady Carolina's territory too?
say:3:1311006003:0.source_cn: 呃，瓦丽卡，这里也是卡列琳娜家的领地吗？

say:4:1311006004:1.text: Indeed, this was the family's forest and her father's favored hunting grounds. Her brother would occasionally visit to capture creatures for his research.
say:4:1311006004:1.source_cn: 嗯，是她家族的林地，她父亲最爱的小狩猎场，她哥哥偶尔也...

choice_prompt:5:1311006004.text: Indeed, this was the family's forest and her father's favored hunting grounds. Her brother would occasionally visit to capture creatures for his research.
choice_prompt:5:1311006004.source_cn: 嗯，是她家族的林地，她父亲最爱的小狩猎场，她哥哥偶尔也会来这里狩猎一些生物用作研究。

say:6:1311006005:1.text: Yes, when he was among the living, her brother appeared to be a well-versed scholar of magic, and the siblings shared a close relationship.
say:6:1311006005:1.source_cn: 她的哥哥生前似乎是个博学的魔法学者，兄妹感情很好。

say:8:1311006007:1.text: He, too, has now become one of the Graveborn...
say:8:1311006007:1.source_cn: 现在的他也是个亡灵。亡灵……不算真正活着。

say:9:1311006009:1.text: Her brother prefers to avoid the company of others, and even I seldom have the chance to see him.
say:9:1311006009:1.source_cn: 她的哥哥不喜欢见人，连我也很少见到他。

say:10:1311006010:1.text: Now that we've located all the undead flames, let us return and unlock the secret door.
say:10:1311006010:1.source_cn: 走吧，亡灵之焰已经找齐了，我们回去打开暗门。

choice:5:1:2.text: Her brother is also a Graveborn?
choice:5:1:2.male: Her brother is also a Graveborn?
choice:5:1:2.female: Her brother is also a Graveborn?

say:0:1311007001:0.text: Chippy hopes we can successfully open the door and find Miss Carolina...
say:0:1311007001:0.source_cn: 希望能顺利打开暗门，找到卡列琳娜小姐……

say:1:1311008002:0.text: Carolina should be within. Let us proceed.
say:1:1311008002:0.source_cn: 卡列琳娜就住在这里，我们进去吧。

say:0:1311009001:0.text: Are you here, Carolina? It's me, Valka.
say:0:1311009001:0.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，你在吗？卡列琳娜，是我，瓦丽卡！

say:1:1311010101:0.text: Callan! Where is Carolina? We have urgent business with her.
say:1:1311010101:0.source_cn: 铐兰！果然是你……卡特琳娜在哪里？我们找她有急事。

say:2:1311010102:1.source_cn: 陌生信号——威胁——卡列琳娜。

say:5:1311010105:1.source_cn: 铐兰？是我，瓦丽卡。他们是——

say:1:1311012001:1.text: Apologies, Callan is now more machine than man. He's forgotten himself and can only follow simple instructions. I hope he didn't hurt you all.
say:1:1311012001:1.source_cn: 实在抱歉，铐兰现在更像是个失去意识的机器，只能履行既定...

say:2:1311012002:1.text: Let me introduce myself. I am Carolina, and this is my brother, Callan. You must be friends of Valka. Welcome.
say:2:1311012002:1.source_cn: 我是卡列琳娜，他是我的哥哥铐兰。你们一定是瓦丽卡姐姐的...

choice_prompt:3:1311012002.text: Let me introduce myself. I am Carolina, and this is my brother, Callan. You must be friends of Valka. Welcome.
choice_prompt:3:1311012002.source_cn: 我是卡列琳娜，他是我的哥哥铐兰。你们一定是瓦丽卡姐姐的朋友吧。

say:4:1311012003:1.text: Welcome, Magister. I'm truly sorry for what happened earlier. What can I help you with?
say:4:1311012003:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，请允许我再次向你们表示歉意。你们找我是为了……
say:4:1311012003:1.male: Welcome, Magister. I'm truly sorry for what happened earlier. What can I help you with?
say:4:1311012003:1.female: Welcome, Magister. I'm truly sorry for what happened earlier. What can I help you with?

choice_prompt:5:1311012003.text: Welcome, Magister. I'm truly sorry for what happened earlier. What can I help you with?
choice_prompt:5:1311012003.source_cn: 魔法师大人，请允许我再次向你们表示歉意。你们找我是为了……
choice_prompt:5:1311012003.male: Welcome, Magister. I'm truly sorry for what happened earlier. What can I help you with?
choice_prompt:5:1311012003.female: Welcome, Magister. I'm truly sorry for what happened earlier. What can I help you with?

say:6:1311012004:1.text: So, you need to enter Whiteridge Temple.
say:6:1311012004:1.source_cn: 你们要进入白山大教堂内部？

say:7:1311012005:1.text: Something may have happened there... I have an ominous feeling that danger is near.
say:7:1311012005:1.source_cn: 或许修道院里出事了……我感觉到那里很危险，非常危险。

say:9:1311012007:1.text: A miasma of madness and fear surrounds the place. For more than a month, this sense of dread has become stronger every day.
say:9:1311012007:1.source_cn: 修道院里有股疯狂和令人恐惧的气息，这一个多月以来，这种...

say:10:1311012008:1.text: Tell me, Carolina, are you still denied access to the temple by the acolytes?
say:10:1311012008:1.source_cn: 修道院的人还是不让你进入大教堂？

say:11:1311012009:1.text: Well, I am a Graveborn, after all. It's already kind of them to occasionally allow me to visit the cemetery and pay respects to my parents.
say:11:1311012009:1.source_cn: 嗯……毕竟我是亡灵，他们愿意让我偶尔去墓园附近瞻仰一下...

say:12:1311012010:1.text: But you have to go to the temple... Perhaps it's best if we report this to the central temple authority and wait for them to send someone.
say:12:1311012010:1.source_cn: 你们……你们最好也不要靠近大教堂。或许我们可以将这件事...

say:13:1311012011:1.text: But it'll be too late for those stuck in the time loop!
say:13:1311012011:1.source_cn: 可那样就太迟了，那些陷入时间循环的人会出事的！

say:14:1311012012:1.text: Carolina, we have to go. It's my duty...
say:14:1311012012:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，我们必须要去。这是我的……责任。

say:15:1311012013:1.text: Duty... Alright, I understand. I can take you to the secret passage that leads to the temple, but I can't go in with you. My duty now is to stay and protect my brother.
say:15:1311012013:1.source_cn: 责任吗……好吧，瓦丽卡姐姐。我可以带你们去通往大教堂的...

say:17:1311012014:1.text: Protect. Carolina. Do not. Leave. Do not. Let outsiders. Enter.
say:17:1311012014:1.source_cn: 保护，卡列琳娜，不出去。不允许，外人，进入。

say:18:1311012015:1.text: Fear not, Brother. I'll be back soon. Just wait for me here.
say:18:1311012015:1.source_cn: 别担心，哥哥，我很快就回来。你就在这里等着我，好吗？

say:21:1311012017:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，卡列琳娜……这样就够了。

say:0:1311013001:0.text: Where does this secret passage lead to?
say:0:1311013001:0.source_cn: 这条密道通往什么地方呢？

say:1:1311013002:0.text: The temple cemetery. There are catacombs that connect to the temple.
say:1:1311013002:0.source_cn: 修道院墓园。那里有墓道与大教堂内连通。

say:0:1311014001:0.text: How come you know about this passage, Carolina?
say:0:1311014001:0.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，为什么你会知道这条密道……

say:1:1311014002:0.text: My family was always connected to the temple. A past hierophant allowed an escape passage to be built.
say:1:1311014002:0.source_cn: 我的家族世代虔诚，兴建庄园时，大主教特别允许先祖修建了...

say:2:1311014003:0.text: But in the end, only my brother and I have used it...
say:2:1311014003:0.source_cn: 不过到最后，只有我和哥哥用上了它……

say:0:1311015001:0.text: This is the cemetery behind the temple.
say:0:1311015001:0.source_cn: 这里就是大教堂后的墓园。

say:1:1311018001:1.text: Go down from this tomb, follow the main passage, and you'll reach the interior of the temple.
say:1:1311018001:1.source_cn: 从这座墓穴下去，沿着主墓道一直向前，就可以通往大教堂内部。

say:2:1311018002:1.text: The inscription here says, "Here lies Carolina Radinov. A maiden with a soul as pure as snow. May she forever sleep in divine light."
say:2:1311018002:1.source_cn: 这墓志铭，“卡列琳娜·拉季诺夫——她安眠于圣光之下，灵...

say:3:1311018003:1.source_cn: 咦，卡列琳娜，这、这是你的墓穴？

say:4:1311018004:1.text: It is, so you don't need to worry about disturbing the dead here. I'll allow it.
say:4:1311018004:1.source_cn: 没错，所以你们毋需担心惊扰亡者的灵魂，我并不在意这些。

say:6:1311018006:1.text: The temple used to be my safe haven, my home. I don't want anything to happen to it...
say:6:1311018006:1.source_cn: 修道院曾是我的避风港，我的心灵家园。我不希望这里出事……

say:7:1311018007:1.text: Lady Valka, you are a hero who fought alongside my grandfather. I implore you to protect this temple and all those who need defending.
say:7:1311018007:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡姐姐，你是和我的祖父并肩作战的英雄。我请求你，保...

say:8:1311018008:1.text: I am no hero, but I vow to do all that I can.
say:8:1311018008:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，我不是什么英雄……但我保证，我会尽全力去做。

say:1:1311019002:0.source_cn: 愿女神保佑你们一切顺利！

narration:0:1311020001:1.text: A mechanical sound can be heard near the coffin. Then, the coffin moves to one side, and the entrance to a secret passage appears in front of everyone.

say:0:1311021001:0.text: I don't feel well... There are strange fluctuations of magical energy here.
say:0:1311021001:0.source_cn: 我感觉很不舒服……有奇怪的魔法能量波动。

say:1:1311021002:0.text: Magister... Chippy feels a tightness in his chest!
say:1:1311021002:0.source_cn: 主人，满满也觉得胸口发紧，心跳变快了！
say:1:1311021002:0.male: Magister... Chippy feels a tightness in his chest!
say:1:1311021002:0.female: Magister... Chippy feels a tightness in his chest!

say:0:1311022001:0.text: Hypofiends? Why are there Hypofiends here?!
say:0:1311022001:0.source_cn: 魔物？这里怎么会有魔物？！

say:1:1311022002:0.text: Oh no, could something have happened in the temple?
say:1:1311022002:0.source_cn: 糟糕，大教堂会不会已经出事了？

say:1:1311024001:1.text: This Hypofiend kept muttering about the Hierophant and a ritual...
say:1:1311024001:1.source_cn: 这个魔物一直在嘟囔什么“大主教”“仪式”之类的……

say:2:1311024002:1.text: I fear that what transpired at the previous two temples may repeat itself here.
say:2:1311024002:1.source_cn: “仪式”……我担心这里也出了和那两个小教堂一样的事情。

choice_prompt:3:1311024002.text: I fear that what transpired at the previous two temples may repeat itself here.
choice_prompt:3:1311024002.source_cn: “仪式”……我担心这里也出了和那两个小教堂一样的事情。

say:4:1311024003:1.text: That monster mentioned the Hierophant several times... Oh no! What if the Hierophant turned into a monster as well?!
say:4:1311024003:1.source_cn: 那个魔物好几次提到“大主教”……糟糕！要是大主教也变成...

say:5:1311024005:1.text: It's pointless to discuss the situation now. Let us go in and uncover what has transpired.
say:5:1311024005:1.source_cn: 现在这样的情况，讨论也没什么用了，进去看看就知道到底怎...

say:6:1311024006:1.text: Time is of the essence. Let us hurry.
say:6:1311024006:1.source_cn: 不能再耽搁了，我们赶紧走吧。

choice:3:0:1.text: The Hierophant may be in trouble.
choice:3:0:1.male: The Hierophant may be in trouble.
choice:3:0:1.female: The Hierophant may be in trouble.

say:8:1311024004:1.text: It's very possible... If we deal with the problem here, the time loop may end.
say:8:1311024004:1.source_cn: 很有可能……说不定我们解决了这里的问题，时间循环就会结束。

choice:3:1:2.text: Maybe the cause of the time loop is here.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 或许时间循环的根源在这里
choice:3:1:2.male: Maybe the cause of the time loop is here.
choice:3:1:2.female: Maybe the cause of the time loop is here.

say:1:1311025002:0.text: This is the feeling of dark magic...!
say:1:1311025002:0.source_cn: 这是黑魔法的感觉，没错……！

say:2:1311026002:0.text: Lower your voice! It's as I feared. The temple here is also conducting a Hypogean ritual, just like the previous two.
say:2:1311026002:0.source_cn: 小声！果然，大修道院也和那两个小教堂一样，在举行恶魔的仪式。

say:3:1311026003:1.text: These cultists have taken control of the temple. The Hierophant must be in danger...
say:3:1311026003:1.source_cn: 这些邪教徒控制了大教堂内部，看来大主教凶多吉少……

choice_prompt:4:1311026003.text: These cultists have taken control of the temple. The Hierophant must be in danger...
choice_prompt:4:1311026003.source_cn: 这些邪教徒控制了大教堂内部，看来大主教凶多吉少……

say:5:1311026004:1.text: I agree. Should we sneak in quietly, we can take them by surprise.
say:5:1311026004:1.source_cn: 嗯，我们潜入大教堂，可以出其不意，攻击他们的薄弱之处。

say:6:1311026005:1.text: If we don't alert them, we'll have a chance at rescuing the acolytes.
say:6:1311026005:1.source_cn: 不惊动他们的话，我们还有机会救出那些被抓起来的修士。

say:7:1311026008:1.text: Therefore, I suggest we <style="highlight">enter quietly</style> and evade any potential ambushes. It would be ideal to discover those orchestrating the ritual and neutralize them in one fell swoop.

choice_prompt:8:1311026008.text: Therefore, I suggest we <style="highlight">enter quietly</style> and evade any potential ambushes. It would be ideal to discover those orchestrating the ritual and neutralize them in one fell swoop.
choice_prompt:8:1311026008.source_cn: 我们还是<style=highlight>悄悄潜入</style>，避开这些耳目，也躲开可能的埋伏。最好能找到举办仪式的人，一举将他们拿下。

say:9:1311026009:1.source_cn: 走吧，小心点，不要惊动他们。

choice:8:1:2.text: A plan worthy of a general.
choice:8:1:2.male: A plan worthy of a general.
choice:8:1:2.female: A plan worthy of a general.

say:11:1311026006:1.text: While I am fond of your proposal, I'm concerned about the potential for traps within.
say:11:1311026006:1.source_cn: 虽然我很喜欢这个提议，但……我担心里面会有其他的陷阱。

say:12:1311026007:1.text: Yes, Lady Valka has a point, Magister.
say:12:1311026007:1.source_cn: 唔，嗯，瓦丽卡说得有道理，主人……
say:12:1311026007:1.male: Yes, Lady Valka has a point, Magister.
say:12:1311026007:1.female: Yes, Lady Valka has a point, Magister.

say:0:1311027001:0.text: Look... there's an acolyte being guarded by cultists.
say:0:1311027001:0.source_cn: 看那里……有个被邪教徒守着的修士。

say:1:1311027002:0.text: Let's find a way to save him.
say:1:1311027002:0.male: Let's find a way to save him.
say:1:1311027002:0.female: Let's find a way to save him.

say:0:1311029001:0.text: There is an acolyte who has been bound.
say:0:1311029001:0.source_cn: 那里，有个被绑起来的修士。

say:1:1311029002:0.text: Let us save him. He's on the verge of collapse.
say:1:1311029002:0.source_cn: 得赶紧去救他，他很虚弱了。
say:1:1311029002:0.male: Let us save him. He's on the verge of collapse.
say:1:1311029002:0.female: Let us save him. He's on the verge of collapse.

say:0:1311031001:0.text: Our foes are too many! These monstrous cultists must be struck down first!
say:0:1311031001:0.source_cn: 敌人太多了，得先解决这些邪教徒变成的魔物！

say:0:1311032001:0.text: The Great Will won't forgive you ignorant sinners! You must be punished!
say:0:1311032001:0.source_cn: 伟大意志必不饶恕你们这些无知的罪人！你们必须接受惩罚！！

say:1:1311032002:0.text: Watch closely! Prepare for what comes!

say:1:1311010001:1.text: Where are you, Carolina? I have an urgent matter that requires your assistance.
say:1:1311010001:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜……你在哪里？我有很重要的事情找你！

say:3:1311010003:1.text: I've never seen her leave the manor since she became a Graveborn.
say:3:1311010003:1.source_cn: 不，从她成为亡灵后，我从未见她离开这座宅邸。

say:4:1311010004:1.text: How could she even stay here? Hmm...? Do you hear something?
say:4:1311010004:1.source_cn: 好奇怪，她怎么会一直……咦？你们有没有听见什么咚咚咚的声音？

narration:10:13011033:0.text: While Valka is looking for Carolina, a peculiar-looking mechanical golem suddenly appears.
narration:10:13011033:0.source_cn: 正当瓦丽卡四处寻找卡列琳娜的时候，一个古怪的机械人偶突...

narration:4:13010934:0.text: You returned to the ruins of Radinov Manor and opened the hidden door with two undead flames.
narration:4:13010934:0.source_cn: 你们返回拉季诺夫庄园废墟，利用收集到的两盏亡灵之焰打开...

subtitle:1:1311086001:.text: The false goddess Dura has abandoned us,

subtitle:1:1311086002:.text: but the true god has sent a messenger!

subtitle:1:1311086003:.text: He has shown us the voice of the Great Will!
subtitle:1:1311086003:.source_cn: 他引导我们听到了伟大意志的声音！

subtitle:1:1311086005:.text: we offer everything to you—hear us!
subtitle:1:1311086005:.source_cn: 我们奉献自己，求您回应！

say:6:1311101001:1.text: It's finally over... How did the Hierophant become like that?
say:6:1311101001:1.source_cn: 终于结束了……大主教他……怎么会变成这样？

say:7:1311101002:1.text: To my knowledge, Hierophant Novik was an exemplary believer. In the years since he came to Whiteridge, even as a Graveborn who seldom goes out, I have heard many speak highly of him.
say:7:1311101002:1.source_cn: 据我所知，诺维茨基大主教是位无可挑剔的信徒。从他来到白...

say:8:1311101003:1.text: Though I have never interacted with him myself, Carolina has spoken of him often, praising him as a kind, devout, and trustworthy man who treats both the Graveborn and humans without distinction.
say:8:1311101003:1.source_cn: 我没有和大主教打过交道，但卡列琳娜曾很多次提起过他，称...

say:9:1311101004:1.text: Carolina held him in great respect. She will be deeply distressed to learn that I was unable to save him...
say:9:1311101004:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜很是敬爱他，我……我没能救得了大主教，她一定会...

say:10:1311101005:1.text: But why would someone as devout as him fall from grace? What's happening here?!
say:10:1311101005:1.source_cn: 可是，为什么像他这样虔诚的人都会堕落……这里究竟怎么了！？

say:11:1311101006:1.text: I struggle to understand... The Hierophant was revered by both the temple and the community. He had no reason to betray the Divine Light.
say:11:1311101006:1.source_cn: 我不知道……我想不明白，大主教深受圣堂器重，也被群众爱...

choice_prompt:12:1311101006.text: I struggle to understand... The Hierophant was revered by both the temple and the community. He had no reason to betray the Divine Light.
choice_prompt:12:1311101006.source_cn: 我不知道……我想不明白，大主教深受圣堂器重，也被群众爱戴，没有任何背叛圣光的理由。

say:13:1311101007:1.text: Faking being a good man for decades? That's incredibly difficult. It's hard for anyone to hide their true selves, let alone pretend to be someone completely different.
say:13:1311101007:1.source_cn: 几十年如一日去伪装成一个好人？不，这是很难做到的。毕竟...

say:14:1311101008:1.text: Perhaps he was threatened... or tempted.
say:14:1311101008:1.source_cn: 或许他受到了威胁……或者是诱惑。

say:15:1311101010:1.text: Could it be the Great Will he spoke of? What in the world is that?!
say:15:1311101010:1.source_cn: 难道……是他说的那个“伟大意志”？那到底是什么东西啊！

say:16:1311101011:1.text: Even I have never heard of that in two thousand years.
say:16:1311101011:1.source_cn: 即便是我，两千年来也从未听说过这个名字。

say:17:1311101012:1.text: The evil rituals, the fall of the Hierophant, and the time loop in Cedartown—these can't be mere coincidences!
say:17:1311101012:1.source_cn: 但教堂里出现恶魔献祭仪式，大主教堕落，雪松镇陷入时间循...

say:18:1311101013:0.text: They must all be connected to the Hypogean! I have witnessed their power and understand that they can pull everything into the abyss.
say:18:1311101013:0.source_cn: 这一切很肯定和恶魔有关！我见识过恶魔的本领……它们总能...

say:19:1311101014:1.text: We have lost too many lives... Callahan placed his trust in us and sought our assistance, yet we failed him and left him in that temple to confront death alone.
say:19:1311101014:1.source_cn: 已经死了太多人了……那位叫杨凯维奇的修士，他向我们求救...

choice_prompt:20:1311101014.text: We have lost too many lives... Callahan placed his trust in us and sought our assistance, yet we failed him and left him in that temple to confront death alone.
choice_prompt:20:1311101014.source_cn: 已经死了太多人了……那位叫杨凯维奇的修士，他向我们求救，他那么信任我们，可我们最后却将他留在这座教堂、留给了死亡……

say:21:1311101015:1.text: Two thousand years ago, I could not manage to do anything right, and the same holds true in the present...
say:21:1311101015:1.source_cn: 总是这样……我总是做不了想做的事……两千年前是，现在还是……

say:22:1311101016:1.text: You've done so much already! Despite the people's fear of the Graveborn, you still did your best to help them. Things must've been really tough for you!
say:22:1311101016:1.source_cn: 可是，你已经做了很多了！这里的人们害怕亡灵，一定让你受...

say:23:1311101017:1.text: Even though this isn't the result we hoped for, please don't hold it against yourself! If you must point fingers... then include us all, because we faced this together!
say:23:1311101017:1.source_cn: 这样的结果虽然不是我们想要的，但你不要因此责备自己呀！...
